body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Astro(www.astrogaming.com) presented its gear bag for guitar 'Roadie bag' at the CES 2009.

The ASTRO Roadie bag is specially designed and outfitted to carry up to two guitar controllers in style. With a lavishly padded interior and ultra-durable exterior, your investment in plastic guitars is safeguarded. The Roadie bag is sized just big enough to fit every first- and third-party guitar controller. The extra interior pocket is big enough to haul a PlayStation 2 Slim or a ton of extra cables.
An easy to reach front stash pocket is also included for car keys, flavors of Skittles the drummer didn't want, and of course, a black Sharpie for fan autographs.
The ASTRO Roadie bag comes in your choice of two liner styles: Barbed Wire and Guitars 'N Cables.
